paths.description: Homepage listing and age-verification entry state; representative global shell, content grid, privacy, performance and accessibility surface.
Category/index archetype selected from primary navigation; request was replaced by Cloudflare challenge during repeated audit traffic.
Representative video-detail archetype selected from the first listing card; request was replaced by Cloudflare challenge.
Content complaint/reporting journey selected as the highest-risk form surface; request was replaced by Cloudflare challenge.

findings.summary: A mandatory third-party age gate obscures all content and offers no cancel, alternative, privacy explanation, or recovery path.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show a full-viewport AgeVerif overlay whose only action is “Start”; the underlying page is blurred and unavailable.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the opaque full-screen integration with an accessible, first-party explained age-assurance flow that states data use, offers a safe exit, and provides retry/recovery.

findings.summary: The age gate and site surface do not visibly adapt to dark preference.
findings.evidence: Light and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots are visually identical: the modal remains a white surface, while DOM reports color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and theme all page and gate surfaces with prefers-color-scheme/light-dark(), including third-party fallback styling.

findings.summary: Continuous loading animations remain active under reduced motion.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found 50 running infinite 1.2s lds-dual-ring animations while prefers-reduced-motion: reduce matched.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable non-essential repeating animations in a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce query and use a static state indicator.

findings.summary: Contrast and high-contrast support are insufficient.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 2.32:1 search text and repeated 4.47:1 duration text failures; the CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Meet WCAG contrast ratios and add forced-colors/prefers-contrast-safe control borders, text, and focus indicators.

findings.summary: Long-page navigation has no state-aware chrome or view-transition cues.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition usage and no modern scroll-state/scroll-timeline features on a 4,411px-long homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use progressive view transitions for meaningful route/state changes and a lightweight scroll-state cue where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt at container level and many interactive targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The probe found no @container rules and measured 55 of 132 visible focusables below 24px in at least one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reused cards/navigation and size pointer targets to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary controls.

findings.summary: Mobile loading misses the good LCP range and ships a broad render-blocking chain.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.9s; HAR identified nine VeryHigh parser-inserted stylesheets plus parser-inserted jQuery, and Lighthouse estimated 67 KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, remove unused theme/plugin CSS, defer non-critical assets, and prioritize the actual LCP resource.

findings.summary: Image and form semantics are missing at scale.
findings.evidence: Images primitive found 52/53 images missing alt; the page probe found two unlabeled fields, and Lighthouse failed image-alt and label audits.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide contextual alt text (or empty alt for decorative images) and explicit labels/accessible names for every form field and control.

findings.summary: Landmark, focus, and target-size behavior is not keyboard-inclusive.
findings.evidence: The probe found no <main>, 55 undersized focusables, and focusing the skip link produced outline:none and no box-shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a main landmark, restore a strong :focus-visible indicator, verify logical focus order, and enlarge small controls.

findings.summary: Most thumbnails lack intrinsic dimensions, responsive sources, lazy loading, and modern formats.
findings.evidence: Images primitive found 51 missing dimensions, 47 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, 52 without srcset, and 11 legacy-format images with no modern-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio, responsive srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold thumbnails, and serve AVIF/WebP variants.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and browser inspector issues remain in production.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices reported three deprecated API warnings, DevTools inspector issues, and a best-practices score of 0.58.
findings.suggestedFix: Update or remove the responsible WordPress theme/plugin code and re-test the DevTools Issues panel.

findings.summary: The declared sitemap is inaccessible to the tested crawler.
findings.evidence: robots.txt declares sitemap_index.xml, but fetching /sitemap.xml returned a Cloudflare 403 challenge instead of XML.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow verified search crawlers and unauthenticated sitemap fetches through Cloudflare, then test the exact declared sitemap URL.

findings.summary: Key browser security policies are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive confirmed HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN, but found no Content-Security-Policy and no Referrer-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, explicit strict Referrer-Policy, and retain the existing HSTS, nosniff, frame and permissions policies.

findings.summary: The page loads a sizable, unexplained third-party privacy surface before user interaction.
findings.evidence: Trackers/HAR recorded six third-party origins and 12 third-party requests, including advertising, statistics, and age-verification hosts; no consent or data-use explanation is visible before Start.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise third parties, delay non-essential analytics/ads until lawful consent, document age-verification data handling, and proxy or self-host where feasible.

findings.summary: Cloudflare challenges block representative category, detail, complaint, and sitemap paths under repeated access.
findings.evidence: DOM/layout captures for category and detail rendered a “Just a moment” challenge rather than site content; sitemap fetch returned 403.
findings.suggestedFix: Tune bot protection so public content, complaint/reporting, and sitemap routes remain reachable; provide a useful retry/contact fallback.

findings.summary: Language and bidirectional layout metadata do not match the mixed-language content.
findings.evidence: The document declares lang=en-US while titles and content mix Bhojpuri/Hindi and English; the CSS probe found no logical properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark language changes accurately, use an appropriate primary lang, add dir where needed, and replace physical layout properties with logical equivalents.

findings.summary: Forms use inaccessible and obstructive input patterns.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found the search field has no associated label; markup uses a mutable value="Search..." instead of a placeholder, and the probe found two unlabeled fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Use labels, placeholders without scripted value clearing, correct autocomplete tokens, and validation after user interaction with announced errors.

findings.summary: Asset and third-party delivery is wasteful for a thumbnail listing.
findings.evidence: The homepage makes 43 requests and transfers 473,255 bytes before access; 47 below-fold images are not lazy, 52 lack srcset, and third parties add 12 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a page-weight budget, lazy-load below-fold media, serve responsive modern images, and remove or defer low-value third-party code.

findings.summary: The visual hierarchy is crowded by advertising and application chrome behind the blocking gate.
findings.evidence: DOM/HAR show multiple advertising redirect links and third-party ad resources while the first viewport is entirely occupied by the age gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce ad slots and non-content chrome, clearly label ads, and let the primary content hierarchy dominate after a proportionate age check.

findings.summary: The available account UI is password-only and lacks modern authentication signals.
findings.evidence: DOM exposes login/reset-password forms; the page probe found no passkey/WebAuthn surface and no active service capability for modern auth.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn sign-in and reauthentication alongside a well-autocompleted password fallback.

findings.summary: The age gate is not exposed as a robust native modal primitive.
findings.evidence: The visible overlay is a third-party injected full-screen layer; the DOM probe found no matching native <dialog> for it and no aria-modal=true on the only role=dialog element.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the gate with <dialog> or an equivalently complete accessible modal pattern, with focus trapping, labelled purpose, safe exit, and restoration.

findings.summary: Body text and dense card metadata are too small and low-contrast for comfortable reading.
findings.evidence: Computed body font size is 12px; Lighthouse flags repeated contrast failures in 12px duration labels and the screenshot shows dense blurred card chrome behind the gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase body/metadata sizing and line spacing, simplify card text, and use compliant contrast tokens.

taskList.title: Replace the opaque age-verification wall with an accessible, transparent and recoverable first-party flow
Restore image, form, landmark, focus, contrast and target-size accessibility
Reduce mobile LCP and the render-blocking WordPress asset chain
Minimise and gate ad, analytics and age-verification third parties
Deploy CSP and Referrer-Policy and modernise account authentication
Tune Cloudflare so public content, reporting routes and sitemaps remain reachable
Add dark, reduced-motion and high-contrast preference handling
Modernise responsive components, language metadata and navigation cues
Remove deprecated theme/plugin APIs and DevTools issues
